data.name: Settings_ColorBy_Desc
data.value: Top folder: one hue per top-level folder, lighter with each level inside. Folder depth: a different color per level. File type: files colored by type. Change: what grew or shrank since the previous scan of the same place.

data.name: Settings_ConfirmDelete
data.value: Confirm before moving to the Recycle Bin

data.name: Settings_ConfirmDelete_Desc
data.value: Ask before deleting. Deleted items can always be restored from the Recycle Bin.

data.name: Settings_FastScan_Desc
data.value: Reads the drive's file table directly, so a whole drive is mapped in seconds instead of minutes. Windows asks for administrator permission once per scan; the app itself stays as it is. Say no and the normal scan runs, and you are not asked again until SpaceSharp restarts. Other file systems and single folders always use the normal scan.

data.name: Settings_HardLinks_Desc
data.value: Reads every file's link count so data with several names, such as Windows' WinSxS folder, is counted once. Slower on large drives.

data.name: Settings_HoverDetails_Desc
data.value: Show a small card with size, size on disk, file count and last modified date next to the mouse.

data.name: Settings_IncludeHidden_Desc
data.value: Off leaves out files and folders with the Hidden or System attribute, such as pagefile.sys.

data.name: Settings_LabelSize_Desc
data.value: Text size on the map, from Smallest to Larger. Title bars shrink and grow to match.

data.name: Settings_LeaveOut_Desc
data.value: Names to skip, with everything inside them. Matched against file and folder names, not paths; * and ? are wildcards.

data.name: Settings_MapStyle_Desc
data.value: How boxes are drawn. Classic: title bars, borders and soft shading. Flat: plain fills and thin lines. Tiles: flat, gapped, rounded. Cards: raised folders. Bands: dark title band. Soft: rounded pastel blocks.

data.name: Settings_MergeChains_Desc
data.value: Draw folders that only contain one folder (Users › you › AppData › Local) as one box with a combined title.

data.name: Settings_OutlinedLabels_Desc
data.value: A thin contrasting outline around every label, so text stays readable on any color. Recommended if you find the map hard to read.

data.name: Settings_Palette_Desc
data.value: The colors used for boxes in the map.

data.name: Settings_Reopen
data.value: Reopen the last scan on startup

data.name: Settings_Reopen_Desc
data.value: Shows yesterday's map the moment the app opens, compared with the scan before it. Every drive scan is kept in %LocalAppData%\SpaceSharp\scans; F5 rescans.

data.name: Settings_ResetQuestion
data.value: Reset every setting to its default value?

data.name: Settings_Scanning_Desc
data.value: Changes here take effect on the next scan (F5).

data.name: Settings_SizeMeasure_Desc
data.value: Size on disk uses the compressed size of compressed, sparse and cloud files and rounds every file up to whole clusters, like Explorer's "Size on disk".
